title: Jigen Ryu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Jigen Ryu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Jigen Ryu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 250 and is learned automatically at that level. The most aggressive school: overwhelming cuts, high cost, less precision. Wield one sword to use it.

At 100% mastery: -8 accuracy and +45% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 10 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
